newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent untraded, NYMEX quiet, awaits London.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent untraded, NYMEX quiet, awaits London.

text.p: August Brent futures were untraded at midday in Asia on Monday but were indicated around the London close.
August Brent on SIMEX was quoted at $18.05/$18.18 per barrel, after London fell 15 cents to settle at $18.06.
NYMEX August crude, which resumed trading on ACCESS after Friday's closure for a national holiday, was last traded at $19.51, down five cents from the last close in New York on Thursday of $19.56.
Brokers said SIMEX would stay quiet until London started trading later. NYMEX was unlikely to offer any direction because of its absence Friday.
